propositions: A new append-only NDJSON snapshot store must persist point-in-time code-health metrics (coverage, complexity, clone count) so their historical trend accrues across CI runs.

The snapshot file must live at `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` and be explicitly un-ignored in `.gitignore` via `!.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` to ensure it is committed and synced rather than silently dropped by the blanket `.rebar/*` ignore rule.
The `write_snapshot(dict)` function appends a timestamped JSON record to the NDJSON file; the `read_snapshots(since, until)` function yields records within the specified date range.
Malformed or truncated NDJSON lines must be skipped during read without raising an exception, allowing the reader to return all valid records.
Unit tests must verify round-trip persistence (written snapshot is readable within its date range and excluded outside it) and resilience (corrupt lines are skipped without breaking the reader).
The snapshot file path must be verifiable as git-tracked and not matched by the repo's `.gitignore` patterns, confirming the series actually persists.
